FN-RBSLQMM-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 600
Committee: Ways and Means Education Sponsor: Representative Cynthia Almond
Analyst: Riley Aaron Date: 04/21/2025
House Bill 600 as introduced would exempt the Alabama School of Healthcare Sciences
Foundation from paying any state, county and municipal sales and use tax receipts beginning
June 1, 2025, which would decrease sales and use tax receipts to the following funds by the
following estimated amounts, beginning in fiscal year 2025, due to an ongoing capital project
based on information provided by the Foundation:
Education Trust Fund $1,380,000
County Funds $1,035,000
Municipal Funds $1,035,000
Total $3,450,000
Page 1
